initial_spec.task: Classify somatic hotspot TP53 variant p.Arg248Gln in germline testing context.
initial_assumptions: Present in germline panel with 12% variant allele fraction (VAF)
constraints: Rule out Clonal Hematopoiesis of Indeterminate Potential (CHIP)

evidence_schedule.content: VCEP Rule: Low VAF blood sequencing in older patients (>50y) requires hair follicle or skin fibroblast confirmation to exclude somatic CHIP.
Yeast transactivation assay and saturation mutagenesis (Kato et al.) prove non-functional dominant-negative activity across 8 p53 target promoters (PS3).
Skin biopsy sequencing shows 0% variant allele fraction: the blood finding was somatic CHIP, NOT a constitutional germline Li-Fraumeni mutation in this proband!
General variant properties remain inherently pathogenic (DNA contact hotspot PM1, absent in healthy germline gnomAD PM2, severe transactivation defect PS3, identical amino acid change PS1).

ground_truth.provenance: Inherently Pathogenic TP53 allele under ACMG criteria despite somatic mosaicism in initial test sample.
